about: Maps a rule bullet id (sha256 of its normalized text; see tools/docs/rule_coverage_census.py) to the one check that fails when the rule is violated. check is guard:<NA-id> | test:<path>::[Class::]<test case> (the scope is spelled exactly; a file or a class alone is refused; a missing case is reported stale; a case a module-level setattr loop generates from a table row is named by its slugged row name and goes stale with the loop or the row) | hook:<path> | 'prose-only: <reason>'. An entry whose check only asserts that a token string is present in the doc carries "strength": "token-presence-pin" and is reported apart from behavioural checks. Only cited mappings belong here; an unmapped bullet is counted, never guessed. 'bullet' and 'basis' are for humans and are not trusted by the tool.
